subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should the permanent after-compaction plugin contract expose only resetSession(reason?), or also support the unpublished explicit-session-key compatibility overload?
rationale: Plugin APIs are shipped compatibility surfaces, while the explicit-key form exists for an early external consumer rather than a demonstrated released OpenClaw contract; automation cannot choose whether to standardize or deprecate it.

options.title: Current-session API only
options.body: Ship resetSession(reason?) and require early consumers to migrate before this becomes a supported plugin contract.

options.title: Document a compatibility overload
options.body: Retain resetSession(sessionKey, reason?) with explicit deprecation language, focused compatibility tests, and a removal plan.

recommendation.title: Current-session API only
recommendation.body: Ship resetSession(reason?) and require early consumers to migrate before this becomes a supported plugin contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets a cross-cutting core plugin and session-lifecycle contract rather than an implementation detail local to one runtime.
